steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You look horrible. Did you pull an all-nighter?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: He's back. I saw it, and it couldn't have been anyone else... That light... It was Andoain's Arts!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Ah... so that's why you vanished in a puff of smoke yesterday afternoon.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: He came to you directly, though?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: He wasn't there for me.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: When I was bringing the mixed-blood girl back to the Basilica... I bumped into a Sarkaz.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: A Sarkaz? Now, of all times? And in broad daylight on the streets of Laterano, too?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: That's right... I went after the Sarkaz and told Ezell to take the girl back to the Basilica.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I chased the Sarkaz all the way to the edge of Pagus Faber... but Andoain covered her with his Arts and she got away.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: As for Ezell, I thought he'd have made it to the Basilica by the evening.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: But he never made it. This is his terminal. It was stuck to the bottom of a vehicle transporting envoys.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Heh, our trainee kid's a good enough actor to fool you?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I doubt he was acting. Though it's true that I don't understand why he did it... Maybe... Andoain kidnapped him, too...?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Fiammetta, I think you really ought to calm down a little.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I'm calm. I'm calmer than I've been in the last eight years.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: But none of you ever told me what happened the day after I left.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: It was a simple mop-up mission... and it went so much better than we expected...

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: All I did was answer a call for backup... I left the rest of you for four hours...

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: And by the time I got back to the ruins, it was all too late.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I've already told you everything I could.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: What exactly did he get from the Lock and Key that gave him the nerve to do that to Lemuen?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I would tell you if I could... but I don't know myself.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Fiammetta, this is Laterano, the Lateran Basilica. We aren't running around ruins in the wilds of Kazdel anymore.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You need to get some rest, Fiammetta. How about I help you apply for some leave? If you don't use your annual leave, it just expires.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Are you serious?!

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: The conference is in two days, and Andoain brought a Sarkaz here to Laterano to kidnap a mixed-blood Sankta girl. He might have even attacked an executor...

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I really let my guard down this time... The Sarkaz clearly knew her way around Pagus Faber. They must've infiltrated Laterano a long time ago... What is that maniac planning this time?!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I'm serious. Calm down.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: The old man's already heard about the Astray, and so has Velliv. I was working in the Basilica yesterday too—Not that I like to think of meetings as work.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: In any case, Laterano is really not in as much danger as you think. Andoain's just a Sankta. He's not a monster with six eyes and four arms. If you really want to take him on, go lie down for two hours.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: We'll talk to Lemuen after that.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Looks like you're not completely out of it just yet.

steps.name: Friar
steps.text: Did you get enough rest last night?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: I'm very well-rested. Thank you for taking us in, senior.

steps.name: Friar
steps.text: The Ecclesia Requietum's doors are always open, as long as you don't find it too depressing.

steps.name: Friar
steps.text: After all, both the living and the dead visit this place.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Given the circumstances, we're fortunate enough to have a roof over our heads. Speaking of which, where is Cecelia?

steps.name: Friar
steps.text: The girl you brought with you? The sisters told me that she slept very well last night. She must have been exhausted.

steps.name: Friar
steps.text: She's had a long day.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Mister Ezell, Mister Friar. Good morning.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Good morning, Cecelia. You're full of energy today.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Yeah... We have stuff to do.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: I asked Mister Friar to help me with something.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: He told me that... there is a ceremony for the family of the dead... to say their goodbyes.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: I want to... say goodbye to Mamma...

steps.name: Friar
steps.text: We will hold a funeral for Miss Feoria.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: I see... A funeral...

steps.name: Friar
steps.text: It's both a way to pay the dead our respects and for us to find closure.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: I'll help you, Cecelia.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Allow me to thank you again, senior.

steps.name: Friar
steps.text: No, not at all. It is my honor, actually.

steps.name: Friar
steps.text: There is nothing more beautiful than finding the courage to take that step forward.

steps.name: Friar
steps.text: She is still young, and already she is saying farewell to a loved one. Not many grown men can handle this journey she is about to take.
May I come in?

steps.name: Friar
steps.text: Oh, it's you. At last.

steps.name: Friar
steps.text: Please, come in. She's here.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: It's the singing cotton candy lady!

steps.name: Friar
steps.text: (Put your gun down. This is a heartfelt reunion.)

steps.name: Friar
steps.text: (It is no different from the countless emotional meetings that have taken place across the land.)

steps.name: Sarkaz Woman
steps.text: I knew it... It's you...

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Cotton Candy Lady, I didn't get to talk to you yesterday.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: I actually really, really wanted to! But I don't know why... everyone started to fight...

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Your horns look just like Papà's. So pretty!

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: I wish I had horns like Papà too... I'm jealous.

steps.name: Sarkaz Woman
steps.text: Hehe... Really? But your halo is very pretty.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: It's so bright that I sometimes can't sleep at night! It helps me read storybooks, though...

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Cotton Candy Lady, are you from the same place as Papà? Why can't Papà live in the city? Why aren't there other Sarkaz in Laterano?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Oh... My name is Cecelia!

steps.name: Sarkaz Woman
steps.text: Hello, Cecelia. Call me... Rosella.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: (Friar... Why is there a Sarkaz here?)

steps.name: Friar
steps.text: (Sarkaz... No Sarkaz have ever been allowed to set foot in our holy Lateran City.)

steps.name: Friar
steps.text: (But then, what is Cecelia?)

steps.name: Friar
steps.text: (Let's go. Give them some space.)

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: (What are you people trying to accomplish?)

steps.name: Friar
steps.text: (We're only... seeking our path forward.)

steps.name: Devout Follower
steps.text: Good morning, Guide.

steps.name: Pondering Follower
steps.text: Salutations, Guide.

steps.name: Smiling Follower
steps.text: May God bless you and keep you, Guide.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: They call you their guide?

steps.name: Friar
steps.text: I don't presume to be any sort of guide or leader. You may call me by my name, Andoain.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: If being a leader helps my brothers and sisters feel at ease and points them in a direction, then I am willing to serve as their Guide. That's all.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: I hope that's all it is.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: I know what you're thinking.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: The mastermind of a heretical cult, lurking in the shadows of Laterano to lead its citizens astray. A man plotting a shocking conspiracy during this important conference that the city spent so much time to prepare?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: No, we wish only to throw open the doors.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: To those who are rejected, harmed, insulted, and desecrated.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: The Ecclesia Requietum will open its doors to them all.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: But both you and I are 'angels.' They are not. The sacred cathedrals and churches of the Sankta have no place for them.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Look at this old man. The Ursus hammering away at the coffin. He lost his family, his friends, his land, and his home during the war. What does he have to rely on, to believe in? Where can he find comfort and salvation?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: After a long journey, he made his way here to Laterano, the land of peace and radiance he heard about from passing travelers.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: But what did this place offer him? How did the glorious Lateran City treat this foreigner who had long been a toy of fate's cruelty?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: See the Caprinae woman watering the herbs? She was branded a whore and a blasphemer for offending a noble, only barely escaping her home when it was set alight.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: All she wanted was peace and quiet, or, if fate would allow her a bit of luxury, a brief moment of leisure and joy every now and then. Do you think the saints in the Basilica will think her their sister?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: To these men and women, our glorious Lateran citizens might perhaps offer them a sympathetic smile, perhaps even passionately hear their woes, maybe even open up their wallets to show their kindness and virtue.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Yet, to the Sankta, all of this will always be somebody else's problem.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: As for the Sarkaz, the 'cursed devils,' the 'crafty devils...' The 'devils' have never had a choice.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Our hatred of them has lasted thousands of years. For as long as history books go back, the Sankta and the Sarkaz have been slaughtering one another. The origin of this conflict is long gone. Our mutual hatred has become common sense.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Father and son slay father and son. Sisters murder sisters. The Sarkaz attack Sankta caravans for sport, while the Sankta shoot their Sarkaz enemies through the chest with greatest pride.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: We are only ever concerned with how we see them, yet we are never interested in how they see us. Vengeance for vengeance grew into custom, and those customs eventually became tradition.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: But, if you are willing to spend the night with them under the same roof, you will find that their joys and sorrows are no different from ours.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: They rejoice when reunited, they weep when one passes, they tease their friends, and they grow bashful when they fall in love. Some of them love drink, others love song. Some of them even choose to dedicate their lives to their faith.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: How are they any different from us?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: In Laterano, even the most devout Liberi friars who carefully follow the Church's teachings, who dutifully carry out their tasks in each ceremony, even those who are made saints and created cardinals...

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: The Church has never truly accepted them. The Liberi are only there to lend a helping hand. They are tools to be used in the Church's day-to-day affairs.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: They don't have halos, which means they... heh, they aren't 'chosen,' they aren't Sankta.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Laterano is a place of peace and beauty, a place full of joy and laughter, but only we are deserving of this 'grace.'

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: What you're saying... is apostasy.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Young executor, let me ask you. Why—

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Why are the Sankta the only ones allowed happiness?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: You know who Cecelia is...

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: We've known for years. She's the child of a Sankta and a Sarkaz. If grace actually existed, she would be it.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: So you're trying to kidnap Cecelia now because of the conference?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: We are not concerned with the conference at all.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: We came to take Cecelia now because, as a child, she should be by her mother's side.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: As soon as we are done with what we came here for, we will leave Laterano.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: What are you trying to accomplish?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: You seem very tense. First things first, we must hold a funeral for Cecelia's mother.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Do you see the place up ahead with all the flowers? That's where the gravesite is. Tomorrow, that's where Feoria will be buried.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: If all are equal when they pass—

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Then so should they be when they live.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Come out.
Executor Federico.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Your Excellency, if I may ask, did you provide the Sarkaz with a path to infiltrate Laterano? If indeed you did, I would be required to take you in to the relevant Tribunal of the Lateran Curia for questioning.
Must we make things so difficult between us?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I suggest you cooperate with the Notarial Hall. Should you resist arrest, regulations stipulate that I can and will temporarily suspend your rights as a Lateran citizen.
How exactly do you explain this encounter of ours with canon laws and teachings?
Should we interpret it as a test, or does it mean we have lost our way?
Or perhaps... losing our way is part of the test?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: It is clear that you are resisting arrest.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Unfortunately, this encounter will not be resolved peacefully.
